title: Please Bully Me, Miss Villainess!
titleRomaji: Qing Qifu Wo Ba, Eyi Xiaojie!
synopsis: Yifang found herself transported into the body of a villainess in an otome game. As the villainess Yvonne, she was supposed to be hated by the readers, as she bullies the FMC and helps the main characters come together. But there seems to be something wrong with this game's main character Elsa! "Hey, I told you not to come so close!" "Oh Yvonne… so how would you like to bully me today..." (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
titleRomaji: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei: Seisan-kei Majutsu de Na mo na Kimura wo Saikyou no Jousai Toshi ni
titleEnglish: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
titleNative: お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛 ～生産系魔術で名もなき村を最強の城塞都市に～
synopsis: Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he’s considered a child prodigy…until he displays the “Production Magic” skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, the memories of his past life, and his “worthless” magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village—and himself? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Baka ni Kokuhaku
synopsis: Ayumu Otsuki is a space lover with an ambitious dream—to meet an alien. Lacking friends or romantic experience, she starts an Astronomy Club by herself, to create a place where she feels she belongs. One day after school, she was putting up a poster to advertise the club when an upperclassman stepped in to help. The upperclassman introduces herself as Hayami, and Ayumu immediately falls in love at first sight with her! Ayumu's mind is now consumed by romance, and she goes all out to share her feelings. However, Senpai seems to already have other interests. She fell for a fitness junkie?! A peculiar girl's straightforward romcom!!
